title: Second sound
description: In superfluid helium, heat travels as a wave, like sound, instead of slowly spreading out. It was predicted by Tisza and Landau and measured in Moscow.
effect: heat travels as a wave in superfluid helium
pickWhy: Works only in liquid helium a couple of degrees above absolute zero.
edbDesc: A quantum mechanical phenomenon in which heat transfer occurs by wave-like motion, rather than by the more usual mechanism of diffusion. Heat takes the place of pressure in normal sound waves. This leads to a very high thermal conductivity. It is known as 'second sound' because the wave motion of heat is similar to the propagation of sound in air.
